title: KLIA2 Food: Where to Eat After You Land
metaDescription: KLIA2 food after immigration: the two food courts, restaurants by level and lot in Gateway@klia2, what opens 24 hours, and the bus from Level 1.

contentBlocks.content: KLIA2 food is mostly in Gateway@klia2, the mall you walk into after immigration, baggage reclaim and customs. Level 2 is the arrival floor, with a food court called Food Arcade and most of the restaurants. Level 3, the departure level, has a second food court, Food District (Gateway@klia2). This guide sorts the places by where you are as you land: airside, the arrival floor, then the departure level. It ends with how to eat and still catch your bus from Level 1.
Key Takeaways
Where is the food at KLIA2? Mostly landside in Gateway@klia2, on Level 2 (arrival) and Level 3 (departure) (Gateway@klia2).
Is there a KLIA2 food court? Two. Food Arcade is on Level 2 and Food District on Level 3. The mall directory lists both as open 24 hours (Gateway@klia2).
Can I eat before immigration when I land? Plan not to. The airside outlets are in the piers and the Satellite Building, past the departure immigration counters (klia2.info).
What is open late? Food Arcade, Food District and Memang Meow Kopitiam are listed as open 24 hours (Gateway@klia2).
Is the food halal? It depends on the outlet. Look for the JAKIM halal certificate at each counter (klia2.info).
Airside, past departure immigration: for flying out
When you land, you walk from the gate to immigration, then baggage reclaim, then customs, and come out on Level 2. Our KLIA2 arrival hall guide shows the route.

The terminal's airside food is in the piers and the Satellite Building, which passengers reach after the departure immigration counters (klia2.info). Google Maps lists Oriental Kopi KLIA 2 Boarding Hall, the boarding hall branch, at S4-03-A05 on the International Departure Level (Airside). It also lists Asia Street Cooking at Gate P as an Asian restaurant. Both serve passengers flying out or connecting.
Coming in, keep your passport in your hand and save your appetite for the mall.
Level 2: KLIA2 food after immigration

After customs you leave the arrival hall by Door B and walk into Gateway@klia2. You are on Level 2, and the mall directory lists most of its restaurants and cafes on this floor (Gateway@klia2). On the Arrival Level public concourse, Google Maps also lists OLDTOWN White Coffee at lot S2-2-1C05.
Food Arcade is the arrival floor food court, at L2-118 and L2-120 to L2-129. The mall describes it as an air-conditioned hall with local and international dishes, open 24 hours (Gateway@klia2).

Grandmama's, at L2-75 and L2-76, is listed on Google Maps as a Malay restaurant. The mall describes it as a Malaysian restaurant cooking traditional dishes and lists it as open 7am to 11pm (Gateway@klia2).
Oriental Kopi is at L2-58 and L2-59. The mall describes its menu as Nanyang food and names its coffee, Portuguese egg tart and polo bun (Gateway@klia2).

DIN by Din Tai Fung is at L2-92 and L2-93, listed on Google Maps as a Taiwanese and Chinese restaurant. Its Google Maps listing name says "No Pork No Lard". That is the restaurant's own description, not a halal certificate. The mall lists it as open 6am to 11pm (Gateway@klia2).
Nanyang Cafe, at L2-94 and L2-95, names Hong Kong style wanton noodles and polo buns on its mall listing, with hours of 6am to midnight (Gateway@klia2).
Memang Meow Kopitiam, at L2-98, L2-101 and L2-102A and B, serves local and international dishes, coffee and desserts. The mall lists it as open 24 hours (Gateway@klia2).
Tea Garden, at L2-133 and L2-134, serves Nanyang food and drinks, 7am to 10.30pm (Gateway@klia2). Its own website says all its outlets in Malaysia are halal certified (Tea Garden).
The hours above are the mall directory's, checked on 5 Nov 2026. Walk the floor once before you choose. The bus counter is one floor below, on Level 1, as the KLIA2 bus station guide shows.
Level 3: the departure level, landside
Level 3 is the Departure Hall, which is landside, before departure immigration (klia2.info). You can go up from the mall without a boarding pass.
Food District is the second KLIA2 food court, at L3-33 and L3-47 to L3-50. The mall lists it as open 24 hours (Gateway@klia2).
Grandmama's has a second branch at L3-26. Google Maps lists it as a halal restaurant, which is the business's own label.
NakNak, at L3-2 and L3-3, is listed on Google Maps as a Korean restaurant. The mall says it serves Korean fried chicken, burgers and loaded fries, 10am to 10pm (Gateway@klia2).
Thong Bowl, at L3-23 and L3-24, serves Thai food, 9am to 9pm (Gateway@klia2). Shake Shack, at L3-30 to L3-32, serves burgers, chicken sandwiches and shakes, 10am to 10pm (Gateway@klia2).
Google Maps also lists Serai Chicken Rice at S2-3-L03 on the Departure Level (Landside), and Jollibee in the Departure Hall on Level 3.
If Level 2 is busy, go up one floor, eat, then head down to Level 1 for your bus.
Halal and pork-free food at KLIA2
Gateway@klia2 has halal and non-halal outlets side by side. A Google Maps "Halal restaurant" tag and a "No Pork No Lard" sign are labels the business chose. Neither is a JAKIM certificate.
Certification belongs to each outlet, not to the brand, and each food court stall is run separately (klia2.info). Read the certificate on the wall before you order.
Eat, then catch your bus

Buses to KL Sentral, Pudu Sentral, Lalaport BBCC and TBS leave from the Transportation Hub on Level 1 (ttklia.com). On the afternoon of 5 Nov 2026 the KLIA2 to KL Sentral page listed departures every 15 to 30 minutes until 11.45pm (ttklia.com). The fare is shown on the booking page.

Book a bus about an hour after you expect to clear customs. That leaves time to eat on Level 2 and walk down. Want to eat without your suitcase? The KLIA2 luggage storage guide lists the counters on Level 2 and Level 1. Landing after midnight? The 24 hour food courts are open, and the KLIA2 capsule hotel guide compares sleeping at the airport with riding now.

content.heading: Eat at KLIA2, then catch your bus
content.subheading: Pick your bus from KLIA2 to KL Sentral, Pudu Sentral, Lalaport BBCC or further afield, and keep the e-ticket on your phone.

contentBlocks.content: Frequently Asked Questions
Is there a food court at KLIA2?
Yes, two. Food Arcade is on Level 2, the arrival floor, and Food District is on Level 3. The Gateway@klia2 directory lists both as open 24 hours (Gateway@klia2).
Where can I eat at KLIA2 after immigration?
In Gateway@klia2. Leave the arrival hall by Door B and you are on Level 2, where most of the restaurants are. Level 3 is also landside (Gateway@klia2).
What food is open 24 hours at KLIA2?
The mall directory lists Food Arcade, Food District and Memang Meow Kopitiam as open 24 hours (Gateway@klia2).
Can I eat airside at KLIA2 when I arrive?
Plan on eating after immigration. The airside outlets are in the piers and the Satellite Building, past the departure immigration counters (klia2.info).
Is DIN by Din Tai Fung at KLIA2 halal?
Its Google Maps listing name says "No Pork No Lard". That is the restaurant's own description, not a halal certificate. Ask at the counter if you need JAKIM certification.
Is there halal food at KLIA2?
Yes, but check outlet by outlet. Tea Garden's website says its Malaysian outlets are halal certified (Tea Garden). Elsewhere, look for the JAKIM certificate at the counter.
Conclusion

KLIA2 food is on Level 2 and Level 3 of Gateway@klia2, after immigration, with two 24 hour food courts and restaurants by lot number. Opening hours change, so open the Google Maps link for each place to check before you go. Then book your bus from KLIA2 to KL Sentral on ttklia.com and eat while you wait for it.
